title: The galaxy (Standard Galactic Grid)
description: Canon worlds in their grid squares, linked to the films, series and games set there.

galaxy.note: Drawn by TimeLiner from data, not a map image. Each world sits in the grid square Wookieepedia gives for it (letters run galactic west to east, numbers north to south). The grid covers the squares Wookieepedia files locations under (C to W, 1 to 21). Where a square holds several worlds they are spread round its centre: the spot inside a square means nothing.

credit.title: Wookieepedia: Standard Galactic Grid and planet articles
credit.author: Wookieepedia contributors
credit.note: Grid squares and appearances are read from each world's Wookieepedia article (revision linked from the place). No map image is used.
